changelog:
- NSD multiplayer discovery fix: TCP connect runs on background thread, fixes NetworkOnMainThreadException
- MulticastLock acquired on both host and client so mDNS packets reach the WiFi driver
- Fix: host sends "start" message to client when both players ready up (client calls engine.resetGame)
- Fix: client parses snake direction data from host state messages (correct head rendering)
- Fix: game over message sent once instead of spammed every tick
- Fix: volatile qualifiers on multiplayer state fields for correct cross-thread visibility
